form.label: CFO — Cyber Financial Exposure & Security ROI
form.description: Links security posture to the P&L: fraud losses, regulatory fines, security spend vs. estimated loss avoided, and cyber insurance exposure. Drill down: KPI -> Channel/Business Unit -> Flagged Transaction -> Raw Record.

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | dedup business_unit | table business_unit | sort business_unit
| inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND is_fraud="Y" | eval net_loss=loss_amount_usd-recovered_amount_usd | stats sum(net_loss) as net_loss

panel.title: Fraud Loss Rate (bps of flagged transaction volume)

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | eval net_loss=if(is_fraud="Y", loss_amount_usd-recovered_amount_usd, 0) | stats sum(net_loss) as loss sum(amount_usd) as volume | eval bps=round((loss/volume)*10000,1) | table bps
| inputlookup compliance_findings.csv | where status!="Remediated" | stats count as open_findings
| inputlookup security_spend.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(actual_spend_usd) as actual_spend

| inputlookup security_spend.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(actual_spend_usd) as spend sum(estimated_loss_avoided_usd) as avoided | eval roi_x=round(avoided/spend,1) | table roi_x

panel.title: Fraud Loss Trend vs. Recoveries by Month

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND is_fraud="Y" | eval month=strftime(strptime(date,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),"%Y-%m") | stats sum(loss_amount_usd) as gross_loss sum(recovered_amount_usd) as recovered by month | sort month

panel.title: Security Spend vs. Estimated Loss Avoided by Category

search.query: | inputlookup security_spend.csv | where business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*" | stats sum(actual_spend_usd) as actual_spend sum(estimated_loss_avoided_usd) as loss_avoided by category | sort -loss_avoided

panel.title: Fraud Loss by Channel (click a slice to drill into that channel)

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND is_fraud="Y" | eval net_loss=loss_amount_usd-recovered_amount_usd | stats sum(net_loss) as net_loss count as fraud_cases by channel | sort -net_loss

panel.title: Fraud Loss by Fraud Type (click to drill)

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where (business_unit=$tok_bu$ OR "$tok_bu$"="*") AND is_fraud="Y" | eval net_loss=loss_amount_usd-recovered_amount_usd | stats sum(net_loss) as net_loss count as fraud_cases by fraud_type | sort -net_loss

panel.title: Flagged Transactions — Channel: $sel_channel$ $sel_fraud_type$ (deepest drill: raw transaction record)

search.query: | inputlookup fraud_transactions.csv | where is_fraud="Y" AND channel="$sel_channel$" AND (fraud_type="$sel_fraud_type$" OR "$sel_fraud_type$"="") | sort -date | table transaction_id, date, business_unit, channel, fraud_type, detection_method, amount_usd, loss_amount_usd, recovered_amount_usd, status

html.p: Drill-down path: Fraud Loss / ROI tiles (Row 1) → Channel or Fraud Type breakdown (Row 3, click a slice/bar) → individual flagged transaction (Row 4). Each transaction_id corresponds to the SOC alert / incident record that first flagged it (cross-reference via business_unit and date in the CIO dashboard's SOC Alerts panel).
